desktop.notes: Help: Feedback and report a problem (Ctrl+Shift+B) with a screen picture and a report number; the user guide updated in English, Gujarati and Hindi. Colours: module colours or your theme in the windows. Widening a column unwraps its text. Design a layout on every print, for those with the right. Nexora AI designs a layout from a picture, PDF or Word file. Tables show at least 5 rows, open large (Ctrl+Shift+L) and scroll past 15 rows. The administrator chooses Nexora AI's languages.
